user.title: Connect Family Life
user.description: You will sign in to Family Life as a parent and approve the connection. Your family must be on the Family plan or above.

data_description.server: Leave as is unless Family Life support gave you a different address.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect Family Life
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to Family Life ended (it was disconnected, the plan changed, or the parent who connected it no longer has access). Sign in again to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach that Family Life server.

abort.wrong_family: You signed in to a different family than the one this entry belongs to.
abort.oauth_failed: Signing in to Family Life did not complete. Try again.
abort.oauth_error: Family Life returned an unexpected answer while signing in.
abort.oauth_timeout: Signing in took too long. Try again.
abort.missing_configuration: Family Life sign-in is not available right now.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out while preparing the sign-in.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL to return to after signing in. Check Settings, System, Network.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: The connection was declined in Family Life.

complete_chore.name: Complete chore
complete_chore.description: Mark a Family Life chore done. A recurring chore comes back on its next day.

chore_id.name: Chore ID
chore_id.description: The chore's id (the to-do item's uid).
